Hi Taylor — thanks for flagging and for sending the PDF. Quick read suggests two possible paths:

1) If the DBA is a registered trade name for the same legal entity (CrateWorks LLC), we can accept your current certificate but we need either a state registration showing the DBA link or a short affidavit (signed and dated) confirming the DBA is owned by CrateWorks LLC. This tends to be fastest for our tax team.

2) If you prefer, you can upload a new certificate that shows the legal name exactly as on your tax registration (CrateWorks LLC) and a signatory whose title explicitly ties them to that legal entity.

Also acceptable: a notarized affidavit or a DocuSign envelope from an authorized officer confirming the entity alignment. If you send one of these, we can request finance to clear the invoice hold immediately.

Cc'ing Ben (Finance) and Marissa (Sales Ops) to keep them in the loop — Ben, can we proceed to release payment upon receipt of either a state file or a notarized/DocuSigned affidavit?
